We need propose a retrosynthesis route with 5 reactions for target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We need to output JSON route with 5 reaction steps (nested). Need to select appropriate templates. We can search for templates matching functional group transformations: protecting group TBS, HWE, DIBAL-H reduction, TMSOTf protection, Still-Gennari. But we need retrosynthetic steps (reverse of forward). So we need to break down target to simpler precursors.

We can attempt to design route:

Target has a lactone? Actually final part: C(O)=O is carboxylic acid attached to conjugated diene chain. The molecule appears to be a polyene with a carboxylic acid (maybe a fatty acid) attached to a cyclic sugar-like core with protected alcohols.

We need 5 steps: maybe 1) deprotect TBS to give free OH (reverse of TBS protection). 2) Remove TMS protecting group (if present). 3) Perform Still-Gennari (Z-alkene formation) reverse: break C=C to aldehyde + phosphonate? Actually forward Still-Gennari forms alkene from aldehyde + phosphonate. Retrosynthetic: break alkene to aldehyde + phosphonate. 4) DIBAL-H reduction reverse: aldehyde to ester? Actually forward DIBAL reduces ester to aldehyde. Reverse: oxidize aldehyde to ester. 5) Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons (HWE) reverse: form alkene from aldehyde + phosphonate. Might be overlapping.

But we need 5 reactions total. Could be: 1) deprotect TBS (reverse of protection) -> free OH. 2) deprotect TMS (if any). 3) Still-Gennari reverse to give aldehyde + phosphonate. 4) DIBAL-H reverse to give ester. 5) HWE reverse to give phosphonate + aldehyde? Might be redundant.

Maybe better: design route:

Step5 (last forward) = TBS protection of alcohol. So retrosynthesis: remove TBS to get free OH.

Step4 = Still-Gennari to form Z-alkene linking side chain to core. So retrosynthesis: break that alkene to give aldehyde on core and phosphonate ester.

Step3 = DIBAL-H reduction of ester to aldehyde (the aldehyde from step4). So reverse: oxidize aldehyde to ester.

Step2 = HWE to form another alkene (maybe earlier double bond). Could be similar.

Step1 = maybe simple starting material like simple sugar derivative.

But we need to produce route with actual template IDs. We need to search template catalog. Let's get available functional groups list.
